sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, 8x8 Block Puzzle is a simple yet challenging game that requires players to collect blocks and place them strategically on an 8x8 grid. The game starts with a blank grid, and as you collect blocks, you'll need to think carefully about where to place them to create a solid structure. Each block has a specific shape and size, and you'll need to use your logic to figure out how to fit them together. The game's scoring system rewards players for using fewer blocks and creating a more solid structure, making it essential to think strategically about each move.

As you progress through the game, you'll encounter various block types, including straight, curve, and T-shapes. Each block has its unique characteristics, and you'll need to use them cleverly to overcome obstacles and create a stable structure. The game also features a move limit, which adds an extra layer of complexity to the game. You'll need to use your blocks wisely to extend the game timer, making it a perfect game for players who enjoy a good challenge.

One of the game's standout features is its endless level design. The game generates a new grid for each playthrough, ensuring that you'll never face the same challenge twice. This feature makes the game incredibly replayable, and you'll find yourself coming back for more, eager to tackle the next challenge.
